lines.text: Thanks for the snacks, you're a legend!

data.define: Used to praise someone who did something great.

example.text: Thanks for the snacks, you're a legend!

misuse.text: Don't call your boss a 'legend' sarcastically.
misuse.why: People may not know it's a joke.

publish.title: What does "legend" mean?
publish.value: Legend = An amazing, admired person. Example: "Thanks for the snacks, you're a legend!" (casual English, UK).
